method: Public manufacturer sources only. Seven original PDFs and two identity HTML pages hashed. Structured facts only; source bodies are not redistributed. Mersen table rows parsed from pinned PDFs; Vishay listed part numbers decoded from documented ordering legends; Sensata one explicit example transcribed with all interruption conditions. All remain pending.

mersen-abat15c.title: Mersen ABAT15C 1500VDC max
mersen-abat15c.note: Battery protection, aBat partial-range fuses. Use the page 2 part table at L/R=3 ms rather than the inconsistent page 1 overview heading L/R≤4 ms. Terminal variants are separate physical parts; item numbers are aliases. Minimum breaking capacity is separate from maximum.

mersen-abat13c.title: Mersen ABAT13C 1250VDC MCS protection
mersen-abat13c.note: Battery/MCS protection, aBat partial-range fuses. Part-level current, voltage and minimum breaking capacity from page 2; family maximum interruption and mass from page 1. No certification or live availability inference.

mersen-abat13d.title: Mersen ABAT13D 1250VDC MCS protection
mersen-abat13d.note: Battery/MCS protection, aBat partial-range fuses. Part-level current, voltage and minimum breaking capacity from page 2; family maximum interruption and mass from page 1. No certification or live availability inference.

mersen-abat13g.title: Mersen ABAT13G 1250VDC MCS protection
mersen-abat13g.note: Battery/MCS protection, aBat partial-range fuses. Part-level current, voltage and minimum breaking capacity from page 2; family maximum interruption and mass from page 1. No certification or live availability inference.

mersen-nhgbat.title: Mersen NH fuse-links gBat 1000V–1500V DC
mersen-nhgbat.note: Battery-system fuses. Page 2 is 1000 V; pages 3–4 are 1500 V. Import only size/current-specific I.R. DC (UL) values from page 1. Do not copy the generic 150 kA headline onto every part; no interruption observation for NH1/NH2 because the UL table omits them. Plain versus bolted blades remain distinct. I²t, derating curves and minimum breaking capacity 2In are not numerically imported. Merge review 2026-10-04: this URL now serves DS-NHGBATF-15-1026_EN with changed interruption conditions. These observations retain the September revision and are historical pending claims, not confirmed current ratings. See components/source-rechecks-2026-10-04.json; review the newer rating basis before acceptance.

vishay-hrha.title: Vishay HRHA charging resistor for EV
vishay-hrha.note: EV precharge/discharge application stated on page 1. Manufacturer-listed identities from https://www.vishay.com/en/product/32594/tab/quality/; identity-page hash and row retained per resistance/tolerance observation and in the import manifest. Resistance and tolerance decoded using page 3, not measurements. Only standard F/C-or-N/J-or-K/B codes imported; TP/custom entries held. Ratings depend on 6 mm mounting material, 30°C ambient and cooling wait. Historical datasheet, current commercial availability unverified.

vishay-lto150h.title: Vishay LTO150H clip-mount thick-film power resistor
vishay-lto150h.note: Manufacturer-listed identities from https://www.vishay.com/en/product/50084/tab/quality/; identity-page hash and row retained per resistance/tolerance observation and in the import manifest. Standard G/J/K, T, E3 ordering codes decoded using page 7; unsupported F and TB7 variants held. Precharge/BMS/EV application documented by Vishay on 2025-04-09 at https://ir.vishay.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vishay-intertechnology-aec-q200-qualified-thick-film-power . The headline up to 75 J/0.1 s is not imported as an unconditional rating. The 500 V element ceiling is not the 3000 VRMS dielectric test; AC/DC is unstated.

vishay-hrha-quality.title: Vishay HRHA quality / listed part numbers
vishay-hrha-quality.note: Identity evidence only: all 30 MAT_NO entries in the page-provided qualityTabResults data, beyond the first 25 visible rows. No products synthesized from resistance ranges.

vishay-lto150h-quality.note: Identity evidence only: all 27 MAT_NO entries in the page-provided qualityTabResults data, beyond the first 25 visible rows. No products synthesized from resistance ranges.

sensata-gfp400.title: Sensata GIGAVAC GFP400 GigaFuse
sensata-gfp400.note: Manufacturer PDF retrieved as web-extracted text; direct original-byte retrieval returned HTTP 403, so no SHA-256 is claimed. Web screenshot retrieval returned no viewable image; visual verification remains pending. Exact ordering example GFPA415B only; active 1500 A production option confirmed on page 3. The revision date is kept literal. DC context is explicit on page 1. Footnote 3 specifies 15.5 kA at 650 V / 12 µH and up to 12 kA at 850 V / 4 µH; do not infer 10 kA at 1000 V. No ordering-option cross-product, pyro-initiator resistance, or universal clear-time claim is imported.
